thread:
Alex Kim: Quick sync: planning a 4-week dev-content drip around the OSS ref app — tutorials, a 30-min webinar, and a benchmark post. Need routing plan for inbound leads. Thoughts?
Maya Singh: Love it. Proposal: week1 tutorial, week2 ref app deep-dive, week3 benchmark narrative + blog, week4 webinar + Q&A. Webinar registration landing page routes to SDR queue + tagged as 'oss-refapp'.
Jordan Lee: For benchmarks let's show latency vs batch size and cost per 1k toks on rw-infer vs baseline. Need dev-friendly reproducible script. @Priya Patel can you own the benchmark script?
Priya Patel: I can. I'll use the benchmark harness from eng-ml, will add a 'faststart' Makefile. ETA Wed. Also: include quantization profiles and perf table.
Sam Ortiz: For messaging: emphasize 'drop-in production inference' and 'predictable cost controls'. Keep CTAs developer-first: GitHub + Try Live Demo.
Alex Kim: Agree. For webinar format: 20m demo (ref app + deploy in <10 min), 10m benchmark walkthrough, 15m live Q&A. Speakers: Alex, Priya, Jordan. Can we get a guest customer?
Maya Singh: I'll reach out to two dev community champions. Also I can create the registration copy. Need slide deck by Mon so we can rehearse.
Jordan Lee: On routing: registration form should have hidden utm and a required 'team size' field to auto-route to tiered SDR lists. We should add an 'I'm evaluating' checkbox for enterprise.
Priya Patel: I'll add a short code snippet for the tutorial: ```bash
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/oss-refapp.git && cd oss-refapp && make benchmark
``` and a sample config JSON. Keep it tiny.
content-bot: Reminder: compliance checklist required for any customer quotes in public materials. Submit to legal 48h before publish.
Sam Ortiz: :thumbsup: Also propose an A/B test on subject lines: 'See inference costs drop' vs 'Ship LLM features faster'.
Alex Kim: Timeline check: draft blog & tutorial by Fri, benchmark results Wed, slides Mon next week, webinar in 3 weeks. Is that doable?
Maya Singh: Yes. I'll create tasks in Asana and add routing rules in the inbound doc. Ping me with any changes.
Priya Patel: Uploading benchmark script to /eng-ml/benchmarks/oss-refapp today — will post link here when done.
Jordan Lee: One more: add a small 'getting started' container image to simplify live demo — no local GPU required.
Alex Kim: Great. Thanks all. Action items: Priya benchmark script + demo container, Maya reg page + outreach, Sam AB lines, Jordan routing config. I'll run the practice session next Tue.
